source: Zhao et al. (2025), JGR Planets, doi:10.1029/2025JE008960
selection: Polygon vertex-average centres strictly inside the interior rectangle
use: Empirical diameter and valid depth/diameter samples, resampled at authored random positions; not a south-pole field measurement.

rock_model.law_source: Yan et al. 2025 Supplementary Material 4, after Li and Wu (2018)
rock_model.cumulative_area_equation: F(>D)=k*exp[-(0.5648+0.01258/k)*D], D in metres, k a fraction
rock_model.limitations: Illustrative exponential fit; Yan et al. report systematic residuals around 0.15 m. k is an analogue control, not a polar measurement.
